empty.title: Draw your first geofence
empty.lead: Mark a yard, a customer, a no-go zone or a route on the map. The platform logs every entry and exit, and alerts you when something goes off plan.

hint.circle: Tap the map to place the center. Drag the square point to change the size.
hint.polygon: Tap the map to mark each corner of the zone. You can drag the points to adjust it.
hint.corridor: Tap the map to mark the route point by point. The width is the total margin: half on each side of the line.

editor.corridorNote: Alerts when a vehicle leaves the route and logs when it comes back.
editor.stayLess: Alert if it stays less than
editor.stayMore: Alert if it stays more than
editor.startDrawing: Start by marking the geofence on the map.
editor.keepDrawing: Keep marking points on the map.

remove.title: Delete the geofence
remove.body: {{name}} will be deleted and will stop alerting. The events it already logged are kept.

schedule.title: When it applies
schedule.zoneNote: Times in {{zone}}. If the end time is earlier than the start time, the window ends the next day.

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. They'll show up when a vehicle enters or leaves a geofence.
